partenairesNous.modesDesc: The 12 questions are the same in both cases. Together, you each answer for yourself and the quiz looks for the kind of partners you are.
partenairesNous.modeDuoDesc: You each answer the 12 questions on the same phone, without seeing the other's answers.
partenairesNous.modeDuoMeta: Your kind of partners and your differences
partenairesNous.modeSolo: On my own, for our couple
partenairesNous.modeSoloDesc: You answer with your couple in mind.
partenairesNous.setupTitreDuo: What kind of partners are you?
partenairesNous.setupDescDuo: Enter your first names. The first person answers the 12 questions and then passes the phone. You each answer for yourself, thinking of what you do most often. At the end, you'll see what kind of partners you are and the questions where you gave different answers.
partenairesNous.setupTitreSolo: What kind of partners are you?
partenairesNous.setupDescSolo: The quiz asks 12 questions about life as a couple, for example about birthdays or arguments. Answer with what happens most often in your relationship in mind.
partenairesNous.relaisDebut: Answer the 12 questions, then pass the phone.
partenairesNous.relaisSuite: {{nom}} is done. Your turn, no peeking at their answers!
partenairesNous.chacunMeme: On your own, you would each have got the same result. You're the same kind of partner!
partenairesNous.chacunGagne: Your result as a couple is the one {{nom}} got. It's the one with the most points when your answers are added up.
partenairesNous.chacunCompromis: Your result as a couple isn't the one either of you got alone. It's the one with the most points when your answers are added up.
partenairesNous.memesReponsesUne: Just one identical answer out of {{total}}.
partenairesNous.accordHaut: You love in more or less the same way.
partenairesNous.accordMoyen: You have things in common but you each have your own way of doing things.
partenairesNous.accordBas: You don't love in the same way at all. That's not a problem as long as each of you understands the other's way.
partenairesNous.invitationDuo: And what kind of partner is your other half? Take the quiz again together to compare your answers.
partenairesNous.noteFin: This quiz is a game. It doesn't say whether you're a good or a bad partner. The photos were created for this page.
partenairesNous.p_soins_d: In your relationship, you look after each other. You think of the other person's needs before your own. For example, you make them soup when they're ill. With you, love shows mostly in everyday gestures.
partenairesNous.p_soins_a: Remember to say what would make you happy too. The other person can't always guess.
partenairesNous.p_clown_d: In your relationship, you laugh a lot. A joke or a silly face is enough to make a bad day better. You don't take yourselves seriously and that's what makes your everyday life feel light.
partenairesNous.p_clown_a: Keep some time for serious talks too. Some things need to be said without a joke.
partenairesNous.p_romantique_d: In your relationship, you love romance. You write each other sweet notes and plan surprises. You never forget an important date. You love saying “I love you” and you love hearing it!
partenairesNous.p_romantique_a: Big gestures are lovely but small ones count just as much. A kind message on a Tuesday morning does the same job.
partenairesNous.p_aventure_d: In your relationship, you love to get out and about. You decide on an outing that same morning and you can leave for the weekend without booking anything. You love discovering new places together. Life with you is never boring!
partenairesNous.p_aventure_a: Plan some quiet evenings at home too. Sometimes you need to slow down to reconnect.
partenairesNous.p_organise_d: In your relationship, everything is organised. The holidays have been booked for months and the weekend plan is ready by Monday. At home, you know who does what and nothing gets forgotten. That's reassuring for each of you.
partenairesNous.p_organise_a: Leave a little room for the unexpected. A day with no plan can turn into a great memory.
partenairesNous.p_calin_d: In your relationship, you need to be close. You kiss every time you pass each other and you watch films snuggled under a blanket. After an argument, a cuddle works better than a long speech.
partenairesNous.p_calin_a: A cuddle doesn't always replace a conversation. When a topic keeps coming back, take the time to talk about it.
partenairesNous.p_zen_d: In your relationship, you stay calm. You know how to listen without interrupting and you don't raise your voice easily. When things go wrong, you wait for the tension to drop before you talk about it. Your relationship is a restful place.
partenairesNous.p_zen_a: Staying calm doesn't mean keeping everything to yourself. Say what bothers you before it builds up.
partenairesNous.p_coach_d: In your relationship, you cheer each other on. When one of you has a project, the other says “go for it!”. You're proud of what the other achieves and you tell everyone about it. You each believe in the other, even on days of doubt.
partenairesNous.p_coach_a: The other person doesn't always need a pep talk. Some evenings, they just want to be listened to.
partenairesNous.p_independant_d: In your relationship, you each keep your freedom. You have your own hobbies and your own friends. You don't need to text all day because you trust each other. In the evening, you have plenty to tell each other.
partenairesNous.p_independant_a: Still keep regular date nights. Freedom feels good when you come back together often.
partenairesNous.q1: When the other one is ill:
partenairesNous.q1a: Make them soup and a hot-water bottle
partenairesNous.q1b: Clown around to cheer them up
partenairesNous.q1c: Sort out the pharmacy and the appointments
partenairesNous.q1d: Stay close by without making a sound
partenairesNous.q2: The first message of the day:
partenairesNous.q2b: A joke or a silly photo
partenairesNous.q3a: A surprise party planned in secret
partenairesNous.q3b: A weekend away, leaving that very day
partenairesNous.q3c: Their favourite meal and a home-made cake
partenairesNous.q3d: A present for their current project
partenairesNous.q4a: A long hug without a word
partenairesNous.q4b: Listen to them until they've finished
partenairesNous.q4c: Remind them of everything they've already achieved
partenairesNous.q4d: Take them out for some fresh air
partenairesNous.q5a: An outing decided that same morning
partenairesNous.q5b: A plan that's been ready since Monday
partenairesNous.q6a: Stay calm and wait for it to pass
partenairesNous.q6b: Crack a joke to ease the tension
partenairesNous.q6d: Go out for some air and talk about it later
partenairesNous.q7: The other one has a slightly crazy project:
partenairesNous.q7b: Draw up a chart with the steps and the budget
partenairesNous.q7d: Take care of everything else in the meantime
partenairesNous.q8b: Slipping a note into their bag
partenairesNous.q8c: A kiss every time you pass each other
partenairesNous.q8d: A silly face through the window
partenairesNous.q9: On a night out with friends:
partenairesNous.q9b: Proudly telling everyone what the other has achieved
partenairesNous.q9d: Each on our own side, then catching up on the way home
partenairesNous.q10a: A plane ticket and we'll see when we get there
partenairesNous.q10c: A sun lounger and a book
partenairesNous.q10d: A romantic spot with a beautiful view
partenairesNous.q11: The little complaint you sometimes hear:
partenairesNous.q12a: Say it and write it often
partenairesNous.q12c: Believe in the other more than they do
